subject: Post-call readout: inference readout & recommended model slate for NovaHealth
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novahealth.ai>, Jason Li <j.li@novahealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call readout: inference readout & recommended model slate for NovaHealth

Hi Emily / Jason — great to chat earlier. Quick recap and the material I promised during the call. TL;DR: we think a two-track pilot makes sense (one latency-optimized variant for real-time triage, one cost-optimized variant for bulk summarization).

Key recommendations (pilot scope):
- Latency track: Redwood-verified model "rw-infer-phi-7b" in fp16/INT8 variant for conversation/triage prompts. Target: 120 TPS sustained, p95 latency ~110ms (serving config attached).
- Throughput track: "rw-infer-neo-large" quantized for nightly batch summarization. Target: 450 TPS peak, p95 latency ~420ms.

Notes on quality/regression guardrails:
- We'll bootstrap with your labeled prompt set (attached) and run an initial calibration run to check hallucination rates on 2k prompts.
- We recommend automated regression tests (prompt-based A/B evaluation) tied to the model profile; if quality drops >4% on critical prompts we trigger an automatic rollback to the previous pinned version.

Attachments and links (in this thread):
- redwood_model_profiles_RDW-3421.pdf — Redwood-verified performance profiles (TPS, p50/p95/p99 latency, and token-cost estimates)
- prompt_set_nova_v1.jsonl — your sanitized prompt examples we discussed
- tps_latency_snapshot.csv — short snapshot from our lab run matching your 8-core region
- Drive folder with bench traces: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwood/NovaHealth-RDW-3421

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm pilot scope (latency + throughput tracks) and success metrics (accuracy thresholds, allowed latency p95).
2) NDA/procurement check (if you want us to share SOC2 artifacts we can start that in parallel).
3) Schedule a 30–45m pilot kickoff with engineering (we can do Tuesday/Wednesday next week).

Would you like me to loop in our security lead (Oliver Brooks from Compliance Consulting) for SOC2 + data residency detail?

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_model_profiles_RDW-3421.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: prompt_set_nova_v1.jsonl (JSONL, 28KB)]
[Attachment: tps_latency_snapshot.csv (CSV, 14KB)]

Thanks Lauren — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying questions before we lock the kickoff:

1) The 120 TPS / p95 ~110ms for rw-infer-phi-7b looks promising. Can you confirm those numbers were measured with the 2k prompt mix we discussed (including ~25% long-context prompts)?
2) Data residency: our legal team will require confirmation that inference traces and KV caches for the pilot will remain in the us-west zone and not be replicated outside the region. Is that supported in the private pilot config?
3) SOC2 / security: yes please loop Oliver in — we’ll need SOC2 Type II and a short network diagram for our procurement package.

Also, can you send a short example of the regression test harness you mentioned? Jason will own the pilot run and wants to see what the automated rollback looks like.

Marissa / Dev — forwarding Emily's reply. Quick internal plan:

- Dev: can you confirm the test harness repo + a short README that shows the regression check (thresholds, metric: accuracy/hallucination delta, automatic rollback hooks)? Emily asked to see what the automated rollback looks like. Link below is where we usually surface the harness: https://console.redwood.ai/internal/harnesses/regression-v2
- Marissa: procurement asks for SOC2 Type II + network diagram and a note on zone-restricted KV cache behavior. Can you pull the latest SOC2 artifact and produce a one-page network diagram we can attach?

I'll tell Emily we can keep all pilot traces in us-west and that we can share SOC2 artifacts and the harness example by EOD. If you both confirm, I'll schedule the kickoff for Wed 16 Apr at 10am PT.

Subject: Re: Post-call readout: inference readout & recommended model slate for NovaHealth

Hi Emily — thanks for the questions. Short answers below and next steps at the bottom.

1) Measurements: the 120 TPS / p95 ~110ms numbers were generated with the 2k prompt mix you shared (including ~22–26% long-context samples). We ran that on a dedicated 8-GPU pool with continuous batching and the INT8 execution path. The raw bench traces are in the Drive folder (tps_latency_snapshot.csv shows sample windows).

2) Data residency: we can pin the pilot to the us-west zone only. KV caches and traces will remain in the zone unless you request cross-region replication. We'll provide a short network diagram to make this explicit.

3) SOC2 and harness: looping Oliver + Marissa + Dev on this thread. Dev — can you attach the harness README and a short snippet of the rollback policy? Marissa — can you attach the SOC2 redacted snapshot and a one-page network diagram for procurement.

Proposed immediate schedule: pilot kickoff Wed, 16 Apr 2026 at 10:00 AM PT (30–45m). If that works I'll send a calendar invite and a short runbook for the pilot.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
